subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: Should secops sponsor these privileged action upgrades as one recreated batch after the conflict and four stale guard assertions are fixed?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but acceptance of the final grouped set of third-party actions used in privileged workflows is an explicit security-owner decision.

options.title: Sponsor recreated batch
options.body: Regenerate the group on current main, synchronize all pin guards, verify the final action commits, and review exact-head workflow checks.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Review CodeQL, app-token, Codex, and Docker publishing action upgrades in smaller independent batches.

recommendation.title: Sponsor recreated batch
recommendation.body: Regenerate the group on current main, synchronize all pin guards, verify the final action commits, and review exact-head workflow checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This team explicitly owns the central security workflows and dependency guards affected by the batch.
